scope: Standard Pandemic, 2015 seven-role base core. Legacy, expansions and puzzle mechanics excluded.
conclusion: No material source contradiction, omission, cost, timing, destination, exception, or end-condition error found in the candidate rules summary.

rulebook p7 Game End; authoritative lines 515-530
checked_claims.assessment: All four cures win; roles support cooperative play. Broad loss shorthand in Overview is made precise in later defeat and draw rules.

checked_claims.assessment: Atlanta station and pawns; outbreaks at zero; cure markers vial-side up near rather than on cure indicators.

source_refs: rulebook p3 Setup step 5; authoritative lines 179-185
checked_claims.assessment: 4/5/6 Epidemics, equally sized face-down piles, one Epidemic per pile, smaller piles at bottom.

source_refs: rulebook p3 Setup steps 3,6; authoritative lines 187-209
checked_claims.assessment: Nine cities receive 3/2/1 cubes in groups of three; nine cards go face up to Infection discard; remaining deck and leftmost 2 marker correct; highest City population starts.

checked_claims.topic: Turn sequence, action count, repetition, active player decision
source_refs: rulebook p3 Play; authoritative lines 189-201
rulebook p4 Actions; authoritative lines 285-290
checked_claims.assessment: Up to four actions, draw two together, infect, pass left. Repeat actions each cost one action. All action-cost discards go to Player discard.

source_refs: rulebook p4 Movement Actions and wrap example, visually inspected
matching-extraction.txt p4 Movement Actions
checked_claims.assessment: Drive follows lines; Direct discards destination; Charter discards departure; Shuttle requires stations at both ends. Sydney-Los Angeles connection matches.

checked_claims.topic: Research station building, supply destination and six-station limit
source_refs: rulebook p4 Build a Research Station and yellow sidebar; authoritative lines 298-302,328-329
checked_claims.assessment: Current-city card discarded; station comes from supply, or existing station relocated if all six built; extras excluded.

source_refs: rulebook p4 Treat Disease and cured-color sidebar; authoritative lines 303-309,325-327
checked_claims.assessment: One cube to supply, all of one cured color for one action, separate actions for distinct colors.

checked_claims.topic: Sharing Knowledge cost, eligibility, consent and hand-limit timing
source_refs: rulebook p4 Share Knowledge; authoritative lines 310-317
rulebook p8 Commonly Overlooked Rules; authoritative lines 557-562
checked_claims.assessment: One matching City card transfers in either direction between colocated consenting players; recipient immediately resolves excess hand.

checked_claims.topic: Cure procedure, payment, location and marker movement
source_refs: rulebook p4 Discover a Cure; authoritative lines 318-323
rulebook p8 Scientist/Commonly Overlooked Rules; authoritative lines 555-556,659-661
checked_claims.assessment: Five same-color City cards discarded at any research station, four for Scientist; station city color immaterial; move correct cure marker to indicator.

checked_claims.topic: Cured versus eradicated, existing cubes and immediate eradication
source_refs: rulebook p4 cure/treatment text and both yellow sidebars; authoritative lines 308-309,322-346
rulebook p5 illustrated cure/eradication example
checked_claims.assessment: Cures do not clear cubes or stop normal/Epidemic infection; eradication requires cure and zero cubes, flips marker and prevents new cubes. Removing final uncured cube has no eradication effect.

source_refs: rulebook p6 Draw Cards; authoritative lines 430-435
checked_claims.assessment: Draw top two together; fewer than two at required draw causes immediate loss, without reshuffle. Exact trigger is stated, despite abbreviated headings.

checked_claims.topic: Epidemic order, sources, destinations and partial-fill outbreak
source_refs: rulebook p6 Epidemic Cards; authoritative lines 436-460
checked_claims.assessment: Increase one space, draw bottom Infection card, add three unless eradicated, fill already infected city to three then outbreak, discard card, shuffle only Infection discard onto existing deck; Epidemic removed, no replacement draw.

source_refs: rulebook p6 double-Epidemic text and sidebar; authoritative lines 408-412,457-460
rulebook p7 Event sidebar; authoritative lines 522-523
rulebook p8 protection roles
checked_claims.assessment: Resolve each entire Epidemic in order; Event window between them. Default second bottom card returns to top and normally causes outbreak, with Event/eradication/protection exceptions recognized.

source_refs: rulebook p6 Infection Rate Track illustration, visually inspected
checked_claims.assessment: Track reads 2,2,2,3,3,4,4; equivalent epidemic-count table correct.

source_refs: rulebook p6 Infections; authoritative lines 399-407
checked_claims.assessment: Top cards equal rate, one by one, one matching cube, eradication skip, no fourth cube/outbreak instead, each card discarded.

checked_claims.topic: Outbreak and chain procedure, recurrence limit and mixed colors
source_refs: rulebook p7 Outbreaks; authoritative lines 479-492
rulebook p7 illustrated Algiers-Cairo chain example; authoritative lines 532-545
checked_claims.assessment: Increment every outbreak, spread matching color to all connected cities, resolve chains after current outbreak, avoid previously outbreaking cities during same Infection card, up to three cubes per color, eighth outbreak loses.

checked_claims.topic: Hand limit, counted cards and Epidemic precedence
source_refs: rulebook p6 Hand Limit; authoritative lines 461-464
rulebook p7 Player Cards sidebar; authoritative lines 526-527
checked_claims.assessment: Seven Player cards, Role/Reference excluded; resolve drawn Epidemics before discarding/playing Events to reduce excess.

checked_claims.topic: Event timing, decision authority, action cost and discard destination
source_refs: rulebook p7 Event Cards; authoritative lines 496-507
checked_claims.assessment: Any player may play Events without action cost; cannot intervene between drawing and resolving a card; playing player chooses use; normal Event discard goes to Player discard, with Contingency Planner exception below.

checked_claims.topic: Airlift, One Quiet Night and Resilient Population
source_refs: rulebook p7 Airlift illustration; authoritative lines 547-550
rulebook p1 component-card illustrations and matching-extraction.txt p1
checked_claims.assessment: Airlift destination and pawn consent match. One Quiet Night skips next normal Infect Cities step, not Epidemic Infect. Resilient Population removes one Infection discard from game, with explicit Epidemic Infect/Intensify window.

source_refs: official-event-puzzle-page-2.png, Government Grant base card reproduction ONLY
checked_claims.assessment: Printed base card adds one research station to any city with no City card needed. Summary paraphrase supported; no expansion or puzzle effect used.

checked_claims.assessment: Six top Infection cards are drawn, viewed, rearranged and returned to top; Infection rather than Player deck. Publisher component supports card identity; unobscured physical-component photo supplies full text.

checked_claims.topic: Immediate victory and three immediate defeat conditions
source_refs: rulebook p7 Game End; authoritative lines 515-530
rulebook p6 cube-shortage warning; authoritative lines 447-451
checked_claims.assessment: Fourth cure wins immediately even with cubes remaining; no eradication required. Eighth outbreak, inability to place actually required cubes, or inability to draw two Player cards loses. Empty supply alone is not stated as immediate loss.

source_refs: rulebook p7 Player Cards and experienced-groups sidebar; authoritative lines 508-514,524-527
checked_claims.assessment: Introductory open hands, Standard/Heroic private by default with experienced-group option for open hands; either discard pile freely inspectable.

source_refs: rulebook p8 Contingency Planner; authoritative lines 582-595
checked_claims.assessment: Action to retrieve discarded Event, only one stored outside hand limit; played stored Event removed from game.

source_refs: rulebook p8 Dispatcher and Operations Expert restriction sidebar; authoritative lines 599-612,676-680
checked_claims.assessment: Both movement options, owner agreement, no nonmovement actions, Dispatcher pays Direct/Charter costs from own hand, Charter matches moved pawn departure, no Operations Expert special move.

source_refs: rulebook p8 Medic and automatic-removal sidebar; authoritative lines 614-630,681-682
checked_claims.assessment: Treat removes all of chosen color; cured cubes automatically clear on entry or presence including cure discovered while present; Dispatcher/Airlift on another turn trigger; prevention limited to cured colors at own city.

source_refs: rulebook p8 Operations Expert; authoritative lines 632-643
checked_claims.assessment: Station building costs action but no card; once-per-turn station departure to any city costs action and any City card.

source_refs: rulebook p8 Quarantine Specialist; authoritative lines 647-658
checked_claims.assessment: All-color placement and outbreak prevention at own city and adjacent cities; setup placement excluded.

source_refs: rulebook p8 Researcher/Scientist; authoritative lines 659-674
checked_claims.assessment: Researcher arbitrary City transfer only from Researcher hand, colocated and on either relevant turn; Scientist requires four same-color City cards for cure.

The provided rulebook sources do not independently establish the ancillary 45-minute play-time metadata or historical verification dates/banner. This verdict addresses scoped rules accuracy and coverage, not those metadata or prior audit assertions.

independence_statement.statement: This was a fresh comparison of only the assigned candidate summary against the complete assigned authoritative rules and matching source materials/provenance. I did not read questions, answer keys, reader answers, reader grades, previous audits, repair patches, or previous reviewer reports; did not communicate with readers; did not assume PASS; and did not edit the summary or author repairs. Only the requested report was written.
